// Sprout — generated Web Component (custom element) for the design system.
// Thin shell: it composes the canonical CSS classes onto its host; the craft stays in
// the source stylesheet (code-as-source-of-truth). Requires the DS stylesheet at runtime.
// Bound source classes: gh-sprout, gh-sprout--sm, gh-sprout--accent, gh-leaf.

export class SproutElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["size", "tone"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this._render();
  }

  _render() {
    const cls = [
      "gh-sprout",
      this.getAttribute("size") === "s" && "gh-sprout--sm",
      this.getAttribute("tone") === "accent" && "gh-sprout--accent",
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const host = this.querySelector("article") ?? this._mount();
    host.className = cls.join(" ");
  }

  _mount() {
    const host = document.createElement("article");
    const deco_gh_leaf = document.createElement("span");
    deco_gh_leaf.className = "gh-leaf";
    deco_gh_leaf.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    host.appendChild(deco_gh_leaf);
    host.appendChild(document.createElement("slot"));
    this.appendChild(host);
    return host;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("x-sprout")) {
  customElements.define("x-sprout", SproutElement);
}
